run_id.source: E1A-R2 run manifest and collector session marker

logical_host_id.source: netns inode plus E1A-R2 interface mapping

netns_inode.format: decimal inode extracted from /proc/<pid>/ns/net target net:[inode]
netns_inode.join_rule: Must map to exactly one logical_host_id for the run.

event_id.rule: Stable unique ID derived from run_id, collector_session_id, collector_sequence, event_type, and raw_event_sha256.

timestamp.rule: Preserve source timestamp and normalized UTC plus monotonic ordering value when available.

ppid.rule: Null only when source does not expose a parent; never silently synthesize 0.

pid_start_time_ticks.rule: Required for PID-reuse protection when /proc is available.

executable.rule: Path and command identity are retained; sha256 may be null only if executable bytes cannot be read.

file_identity.rule: Field is always present; null is allowed for events without a file object.

socket_identity.rule: Field is always present; null is allowed for events without a socket object.

raw_event_bytes_b64.rule: Exact bytes received from auditd or supplemental source before normalization.

collector_metadata.rule: Retain source version, stream sequence, and loss/drop counters with every event or an adjacent loss record.

source_records: audit fork/clone/vfork or equivalent process-start record
PROCESS_START.normalization: Create one PROCESS node identity; link parent PID/start ticks when present.

PROCESS_EXEC.normalization: Attach executable FILE identity and update PROCESS executable identity without losing the pre-exec identity.

source_records: audit EXIT or process termination record
PROCESS_EXIT.normalization: Close PROCESS lifetime interval; retain missing-exit status as an explicit validation failure.

source_records: audit open/openat/creat syscall and PATH records
FILE_CREATE_OR_OPEN.normalization: Resolve device/inode/path and create or reference a FILE node; preserve unresolved-path status.

source_records: audit read/pread/readv/write/pwrite/writev syscall records when rules are enabled
FILE_READ_OR_WRITE.normalization: Emit PROCESS reads/writes FILE edges with byte counts and syscall result.

source_records: audit unlink/unlinkat/rename/renameat syscall and PATH records
FILE_DELETE.normalization: Close FILE lifetime or create a rename edge; do not infer deletion from absence alone.

source_records: audit bind syscall record plus /proc/<pid>/net and socket inode join
SOCKET_BIND.normalization: Create SOCKET node keyed by netns, protocol, endpoint, and inode; require live /proc or ss evidence during smoke validation.

source_records: audit connect/accept/accept4 syscall records plus socket inode join
SOCKET_CONNECT_OR_ACCEPT.normalization: Create or update SOCKET connection interval and link PROCESS to the accepting/connecting socket.

source_records: bounded tcpdump packet record joined to socket/process event
NETWORK_CORRELATION.normalization: Bind packet timestamp/interface/five-tuple to a SOCKET and logical_host_id; preserve unmatched packets as explicit unjoined records.

event_presence_rules.null_identity_rule: Only the object not involved in a given event may be null; the field itself must never be omitted.
event_presence_rules.pid_reuse_rule: A PID without pid_start_time_ticks is not sufficient for a long-lived causal graph join.
event_presence_rules.loss_rule: Any nonzero collector loss/drop counter blocks a complete-graph claim and is retained in run evidence.

logical_host_join.join_result: exactly one logical_host_id h1 or h2, otherwise UNJOINED

parsing.timestamp_order: source timestamp, then audit serial/collector sequence, then monotonic_ns
parsing.deterministic_replay: Replaying identical raw bytes with the same decoder version must produce byte-identical normalized JSON.
